class EditPageSourceUntouchedSaveTest(ServerTestCase):
    """未改来源（或仅增删首尾空白）的保存：原来源完整文字逐字节保留。"""

    LF_SOURCE = "现场录音/第一段\n第二段：分轨 01.flac\n  缩进行  \n\n结尾段"
    CRLF_SOURCE = LF_SOURCE.replace("\n", "\r\n")
    CR_SOURCE = "第一段\r第二段\r第三段"

    def save_via_form(self, track, **changes):
        """模拟浏览器：打开编辑页，整表取回（textarea 换行按 CRLF 提交）。"""
        page = self.get_edit_page(track["id"])
        fields = self.edit_fields_from_rendered_page(page)
        fields = [
            (name, browser_newlines(value))
            if name in ("source", "description", "tags") else (name, value)
            for name, value in fields
        ]
        for name, value in changes.items():
            fields = self.form_with_field(fields, name, value)
        return self.post_edit_form(track["id"], fields)

    def assert_source_preserved(self, source):
        track = self.create_track(title="多行来源曲目", source=source)
        status, _, page = self.save_via_form(track, title="只改了名称")
        self.assertEqual(status, 303, page[:500])
        record = self.track_by_id(track["id"])
        self.assertEqual(record["title"], "只改了名称")
        # 原来源逐字节保留：换行写法不因网页显示与表单提交被改写。
        self.assertEqual(record["source"], source)
        return record

    def test_lf_source_survives_browser_crlf_submission(self):
        record = self.assert_source_preserved(self.LF_SOURCE)
        self.assertNotIn("\r", record["source"])

    def test_crlf_source_survives_browser_crlf_submission(self):
        record = self.assert_source_preserved(self.CRLF_SOURCE)
        self.assertIn("\r\n", record["source"])

    def test_cr_source_survives_browser_crlf_submission(self):
        record = self.assert_source_preserved(self.CR_SOURCE)
        self.assertIn("\r", record["source"])
        self.assertNotIn("\r\n", record["source"])

    def test_repeated_resaves_keep_source_stable(self):
        track = self.create_track(title="反复保存", source=self.CRLF_SOURCE)
        for round_index in range(2):
            status, _, page = self.save_via_form(
                self.track_by_id(track["id"]), title=f"第 {round_index} 次改名",
            )
            self.assertEqual(status, 303, page[:500])
            self.assertEqual(
                self.track_by_id(track["id"])["source"], self.CRLF_SOURCE
            )

    def test_surrounding_whitespace_only_counts_as_untouched(self):
        track = self.create_track(title="首尾空白", source=self.CRLF_SOURCE)
        page = self.get_edit_page(track["id"])
        fields = self.edit_fields_from_rendered_page(page)
        # 用户只在来源首尾增删空白（含换行），内部一字未动。
        padded = "  \r\n" + browser_newlines(self.LF_SOURCE) + "\t \r\n"
        fields = self.form_with_field(fields, "source", padded)
        status, _, page = self.post_edit_form(track["id"], fields)
        self.assertEqual(status, 303, page[:500])
        # 仍保留原来源的完整文字，不按去掉首尾空白后的文字重写。
        self.assertEqual(
            self.track_by_id(track["id"])["source"], self.CRLF_SOURCE
        )

    def test_newline_style_variants_stay_two_distinct_sources(self):
        # 两段来源只在内部换行写法上不同：各自保留，打开编辑页再保存
        # 不会把它们变成同一个来源。
        lf_track = self.create_track(title="LF 版本", source="甲\n乙")
        crlf_track = self.create_track(title="CRLF 版本", source="甲\r\n乙")

        status, _, page = self.save_via_form(lf_track, title="LF 版本（改名）")
        self.assertEqual(status, 303, page[:500])
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(lf_track["id"])["source"], "甲\n乙")
        self.assertEqual(
            self.track_by_id(crlf_track["id"])["source"], "甲\r\n乙"
        )

        status, _, page = self.save_via_form(crlf_track, title="CRLF 版本（改名）")
        self.assertEqual(status, 303, page[:500])
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(lf_track["id"])["source"], "甲\n乙")
        self.assertEqual(
            self.track_by_id(crlf_track["id"])["source"], "甲\r\n乙"
        )

    def test_newline_stripped_collision_does_not_block_untouched_save(self):
        # 另一曲目的来源恰好等于本来源去掉换行后的文字：不影响未改来源的保存。
        multiline = self.create_track(title="多行来源", source="甲\n乙")
        flat = self.create_track(title="单行来源", source="甲乙")

        status, _, page = self.save_via_form(multiline, title="多行来源（改名）")
        self.assertEqual(status, 303, page[:500])
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(multiline["id"])["source"], "甲\n乙")
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(flat["id"])["source"], "甲乙")

    def test_same_multiline_source_versions_edit_via_form_succeeds(self):
        # 其他版本共用同一多行来源时，网页编辑其中一条的其他资料仍应成功。
        shared = "共用来源/第一段\n第二段.flac"
        first = self.create_track(title="版本一", source=shared, duration=100)
        second = self.create_track(
            title="版本二", source=shared, duration=200,
            save_as_new_version=True,
        )
        status, _, page = self.save_via_form(second, title="版本二（改名）")
        self.assertEqual(status, 303, page[:500])
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(second["id"])["source"], shared)
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(first["id"]), first)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.list_tracks()), 2)


class EditPageSourceChangesTest(ServerTestCase):
    """确实修改来源内部文字、空格或分行：按本次填写（LF）去掉首尾空白保存。"""

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.track = self.create_track(
            title="待改来源", source="/music/old.flac", duration=120,
            description="原始说明",
        )
        self.track_id = self.track["id"]

    def submit_source(self, source_text, **changes):
        page = self.get_edit_page(self.track_id)
        fields = self.edit_fields_from_rendered_page(page)
        fields = self.form_with_field(fields, "source", source_text)
        for name, value in changes.items():
            fields = self.form_with_field(fields, name, value)
        return self.post_edit_form(self.track_id, fields)

    def test_edited_source_saved_with_lf_newlines_and_trimmed(self):
        typed = "  新的来源/第一段\r\n第二段  \r\n\r\n第三段\r\n "
        status, headers, page = self.submit_source(typed)
        self.assertEqual(status, 303, page[:500])

        self.assertEqual(status, 303, page[:500])

        self.assertEqual(status, 303, page[:500])
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.track_id)["source"], "a  b.flac")

    def test_changed_source_matching_other_track_is_rejected(self):
        occupant = self.create_track(title="实际占用者", source="乙\n丙")

        status, _, page = self.submit_source("乙\r\n丙")
        self.assertEqual(status, 409, page[:500])
        self.assertEqual(
            parse_conflict_items(page), [(occupant["id"], "实际占用者")]
        )
        # 整条曲目保持原样，页面保留本次填写的来源与其他资料。
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.track_id), self.track)
        self.assertEqual(parse_source_box(page), "乙\n丙")
        self.assert_form_values(page, title="待改来源", duration="120")

        # 用户改成未占用的来源后继续保存：采用回填内容，标识不变。
        status, headers, page = self.submit_source("/music/free.flac")
        self.assertEqual(status, 303, page[:500])
        record = self.track_by_id(self.track_id)
        self.assertEqual(record["source"], "/music/free.flac")
        self.assertEqual(record["id"], self.track_id)

    def test_clearing_existing_source_is_rejected(self):

                status, _, page = self.submit_source(blank)

                banner = BANNER_ERROR_RE.search(page)

                self.assertIn("来源", strip_tags(banner.group(1)))
                # 已有来源不能被清空：整条记录保持原样。
                self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.track_id), self.track)

class CreateDuplicateSourceApiTest(ServerTestCase):
    """收录接口（POST /api/tracks）：同一来源默认 409 拒绝，不写入不改旧记录。"""

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.first = self.create_track(
            title="夜航·首版",
            source="/music/yehang.flac",
            duration=243.5,
            cover_url="https://img.example/yehang.png",
            description="首版说明",
            tags=["民谣", "现场"],
        )
        self.second = self.create_track(
            title="夜航·重制",
            source="/music/yehang.flac",
            duration=250,
            cover_url="https://img.example/yehang-remaster.png",
            description="重制说明",
            tags=["民谣", "重制"],
            save_as_new_version=True,
        )
        self.bystander = self.create_track(
            title="无关曲目", source="/music/other.flac", duration=9,
        )

    def duplicate_payload(self, **overrides):
        payload = {
            "title": "夜航·候选版本",
            "source": " \t/music/yehang.flac\n ",
            "duration": 307.25,
            "cover_url": "https://img.example/candidate.png",
            "description": "候选说明\n与已有记录都不同",
            "tags": ["候选", "新编"],
        }
        payload.update(overrides)
        return payload

    def test_duplicate_source_without_flag_returns_409(self):
        # 来源仅首尾空白不同；名称、说明等资料完全不同也必须拒绝。
        status, body = self.server.request(
            "POST", "/api/tracks", self.duplicate_payload()
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 409, body)
        self.assertEqual(body["field"], "source")
        # existing 列出该来源的全部已有记录，只含 id 与 title，
        # 按标识升序，不混入其他来源的曲目。
        self.assertEqual(body["existing"], [
            {"id": self.first["id"], "title": "夜航·首版"},
            {"id": self.second["id"], "title": "夜航·重制"},
        ])

    def test_explicit_false_is_also_rejected(self):
        status, body = self.server.request(
            "POST", "/api/tracks",
            self.duplicate_payload(save_as_new_version=False),
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 409, body)
        self.assertEqual(
            [item["id"] for item in body["existing"]],
            [self.first["id"], self.second["id"]],
        )

    def test_existing_lists_every_version_in_id_order(self):
        # 该来源已有三个版本时，existing 仍要全部列出且按标识升序。
        third = self.create_track(
            title="夜航·现场版",
            source="/music/yehang.flac",
            save_as_new_version=True,
        )
        status, body = self.server.request(
            "POST", "/api/tracks", self.duplicate_payload()
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 409, body)
        self.assertEqual(body["existing"], [
            {"id": self.first["id"], "title": "夜航·首版"},
            {"id": self.second["id"], "title": "夜航·重制"},
            {"id": third["id"], "title": "夜航·现场版"},
        ])

    def test_rejection_creates_nothing_and_changes_nothing(self):
        status, _ = self.server.request(
            "POST", "/api/tracks", self.duplicate_payload()
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 409)

        tracks = self.list_tracks()
        # 拒绝没有新增任何记录。
        self.assertEqual(len(tracks), 3)
        self.assertEqual(
            [t["id"] for t in tracks],
            [self.first["id"], self.second["id"], self.bystander["id"]],
        )
        # 任一已有记录的资料都没有被候选资料覆盖或合并。
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.first["id"]), self.first)
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.second["id"]), self.second)
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.bystander["id"]), self.bystander)

    def test_other_sources_with_same_title_are_not_listed(self):
        # 同名但来源不同的曲目不属于该来源的冲突记录。
        same_title = self.create_track(
            title="夜航·首版", source="/music/different.flac",
        )
        status, body = self.server.request(
            "POST", "/api/tracks", self.duplicate_payload()
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 409, body)
        existing_ids = {item["id"] for item in body["existing"]}
        self.assertNotIn(same_title["id"], existing_ids)
        self.assertNotIn(self.bystander["id"], existing_ids)

class CreateSourceDistinctionApiTest(ServerTestCase):

    def test_same_title_different_source_succeeds(self):

        status, body = self.server.request("POST", "/api/tracks", {
            "title": "同名曲目",

        })

        # 内部多一个空格、大小写不同都不是同一来源；不勾选另存也直接成功。
        base = self.create_track(title="内部空格", source="/music/a b.flac")
        status, double_space = self.server.request("POST", "/api/tracks", {
            "title": "内部两个空格",
            "source": "/music/a  b.flac",
        })

class SaveAsNewVersionTypeValidationTest(ServerTestCase):
    """save_as_new_version 只接受布尔值：字符串/数字一律 400 且不写入。"""

    def setUp(self):

        self.existing = self.create_track(
            title="已存在", source="/music/taken.flac",
        )

    def test_non_bool_values_against_duplicate_source_are_400(self):
        for bad in ("true", "false", "1", "0", "yes", 1, 0):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                status, body = self.server.request("POST", "/api/tracks", {
                    "title": "试图靠字符串/数字蒙混另存",
                    "source": "/music/taken.flac",

                })

                self.assertEqual(body["field"], "save_as_new_version")
                self.assertIn("save_as_new_version", body["error"])
                # 既没有把 "true"/1 当作同意另存，也没有写入任何新曲目。
                self.assertEqual(len(self.list_tracks()), 1)
                self.assertEqual(
                    self.track_by_id(self.existing["id"]), self.existing
                )

        )

class CreateRequiredFieldApiTest(ServerTestCase):
    """收录接口：名称/来源缺失或不合法时 400 且不产生不完整记录。

    所有用例的来源都使用尚未收录的文字，使失败明确属于必填资料错误，
    而不是来源重复冲突（409）。
    """

    # 与出错必填项一起提交的选填资料全部合法：即使如此也整单不写入。
    OPTIONAL_FIELDS = {
        "duration": 243.5,
        "cover_url": "https://img.example/candidate.png",
        "description": "候选说明：中文、换行\n第二行",
        "tags": ["候选", "新编"],
    }
    VALID_TITLE = "山涧晨曲"
    # 每次按用例名派生未收录来源，避免任何子例之间发生来源重复。
    SOURCE_COUNTER = 0

    def bad_payload(self, field, bad_value, *, with_optional):
        payload = {"title": self.VALID_TITLE, "source": self.free_source()}
        payload[field] = bad_value
        if with_optional:
            payload.update(self.OPTIONAL_FIELDS)
        return payload

    def free_source(self):
        CreateRequiredFieldApiTest.SOURCE_COUNTER += 1
        return f"/music/required-{CreateRequiredFieldApiTest.SOURCE_COUNTER}.flac"

    def assert_required_error(self, status, body, field, label):
        self.assertEqual(status, 400, body)
        # field 指向出错的那个必填字段。
        self.assertEqual(body["field"], field)
        # 错误文字说明该字段不合法（含其中文名称）。
        self.assertIn(label, body["error"])
        # 绝不是来源重复冲突的响应。
        self.assertNotIn("existing", body)

    def assert_nothing_saved(self):
        # 失败不能产生一条不完整的曲目。
        self.assertEqual(self.list_tracks(), [])

    def assert_cases_for_field(self, field, label, bad_values):
        for bad in bad_values:
            with self.subTest(field=field, bad=repr(bad)):
                payload = self.bad_payload(field, bad, with_optional=True)
                status, body = self.server.request(
                    "POST", "/api/tracks", payload
                )
                self.assert_required_error(status, body, field, label)
                self.assert_nothing_saved()

    def test_title_missing_null_blank_and_non_strings_are_rejected(self):
        # 省略名称、null、空字符串、只有空白的字符串，以及数字、布尔值、
        # 数组、对象：另一项（来源）与全部选填资料合法也不能写入。
        bad_values = [None, "", " ", "\t", " \n\t\r ",
                      0, 1, 243.5, False, True, [], ["名称"], {}, {"a": 1}]
        self.assert_cases_for_field("title", "名称", bad_values)

    def test_source_missing_null_blank_and_non_strings_are_rejected(self):
        bad_values = [None, "", " ", "\t", "  \t\n ",
                      0, 3, 243.5, False, True, [], ["/x"], {}, {"a": 1}]
        self.assert_cases_for_field("source", "来源", bad_values)

    def test_omitted_field_omits_the_key_entirely(self):
        # “省略”必须是请求里根本没有该键，而不是提交 null；两种形态都拒绝。
        for field, label in (("title", "名称"), ("source", "来源")):
            with self.subTest(field=field):
                payload = {"title": self.VALID_TITLE, "source": self.free_source()}
                del payload[field]
                status, body = self.server.request(
                    "POST", "/api/tracks", payload
                )
                self.assert_required_error(status, body, field, label)
                self.assert_nothing_saved()

    def test_optional_only_payloads_with_one_bad_required_are_atomic(self):
        # 每次只让一个必填字段出错；合法的另一项与选填资料不先写入。
        # 这里覆盖“出错字段给字符串类型但为空白”与“类型错误”两类，
        # 并显式断言数据库没有新增记录。
        cases = [
            ("title", "   "), ("title", 123), ("title", True),
            ("title", []), ("title", {}),
            ("source", "\t\n"), ("source", 456), ("source", False),
            ("source", []), ("source", {}),
        ]
        for field, bad in cases:
            with self.subTest(field=field, bad=repr(bad)):
                payload = self.bad_payload(field, bad, with_optional=True)
                status, body = self.server.request(
                    "POST", "/api/tracks", payload
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400, body)
                self.assertEqual(body["field"], field)
                self.assert_nothing_saved()

    def test_chinese_title_and_source_with_chinese_path_are_saved(self):
        # 有效收录对照：中文名称、含中文目录的来源可以保存；首尾空白被
        # 去掉，内部文字与标点（含连续空格）原样保留。
        payload = {
            "title": "  夜航·前奏（live）  ",
            "source": "\t/音乐/现场 录音/夜航 序曲.flac\n",
        }
        status, body = self.server.request("POST", "/api/tracks", payload)
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, body)
        self.assertEqual(body["title"], "夜航·前奏（live）")
        self.assertEqual(body["source"], "/音乐/现场 录音/夜航 序曲.flac")
        # 省略选填资料仍按既有默认结果保存：时长未知、封面和说明为空、
        # 标签为空数组。
        self.assertIsNone(body["duration"])
        self.assertEqual(body["cover_url"], "")
        self.assertEqual(body["description"], "")
        self.assertEqual(body["tags"], [])
        # 成功响应与随后列表读到的记录一致。
        tracks = self.list_tracks()
        self.assertEqual(len(tracks), 1)
        self.assertEqual(tracks[0], body)

    def test_valid_create_with_all_optional_fields_round_trips(self):
        # 第二个对照：选填资料齐全的有效收录同样成功，防止上面的拒绝
        # 用例把合法资料也误伤。
        payload = {
            "title": "晨曲",
            "source": self.free_source(),
            **self.OPTIONAL_FIELDS,
        }
        status, body = self.server.request("POST", "/api/tracks", payload)

        )

随后读取列表，标签文字与顺序和成功响应一致。 5179 self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.track_id)["tags"], expected) 5180 5181 def test_trim_ignore_empty_and_dedup_by_full_text(self): 5182 # 各项去掉首尾空白、忽略空项；只有完整文字相同才去重， 5183 # 保留第一次出现的先后位置。 5184 self.assert_tags_saved( 5185 [" 民谣 ", "", " ", "\n", "民谣", "现场", " 现场 ", "民谣"], 5186 ["民谣", "现场"], 5187 ) 5188 5189 def test_punctuation_is_tag_text_not_separator(self): 5190 # 中英文逗号和顿号属于标签文字，不能拆成多个标签。 5191 tags = ["民谣，现场", "摇滚、独立", "a,b", "中文，逗号、顿号,都保留"] 5192 self.assert_tags_saved(tags, tags) 5193 5194 def test_chinese_and_blank_lines_inside_tag_are_kept(self): 5195 # 中文与项内空行原样保存，一个多行标签仍是一项。 5196 tags = ["第一段\n\n第三段", "中文标签"] 5197 self.assert_tags_saved(tags, tags) 5198 5199 def test_multiline_tag_and_single_line_of_it_are_two_items(self): 5200 # 一个多行标签与只写其中一行的另一个标签仍是两项。 5201 tags = ["第一行\n第二行", "第二行"] 5202 self.assert_tags_saved(tags, tags) 5203 5204 def test_lf_and_crlf_variants_are_not_merged(self): 5205 # 仅内部换行写法不同（LF 与 CRLF）的两项不能被合并， 5206 # 保存后各自保留提交的换行写法。 5207 tags = ["甲\n乙", "甲\r\n乙"] 5208 self.assert_tags_saved(tags, tags) 5209 5210 5211 class EditTagsOmitAndClearTest(ServerTestCase): 5212 """未提交 tags 保留原标签；明确提交空数组或 null 则清空标签。""" 5213 5214 def setUp(self): 5215 super().setUp() 5216 self.track = self.create_track( 5217 title="夜航", 5218 source="/music/yehang.flac", 5219 duration=243.5, 5220 cover_url="https://img.example/yehang.png", 5221 description="首版说明", 5222 tags=["民谣", "现场"], 5223 ) 5224 self.track_id = self.track["id"] 5225 5226 def test_omitting_tags_keeps_content_and_order(self): 5227 # 只修改名称或说明、没有提交 tags 时，原标签内容与顺序不变。 5228 status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, { 5229 "title": "夜航（改名）", 5230 "description": "新说明", 5231 }) 5232 self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) 5233 self.assertEqual(body["tags"], ["民谣", "现场"]) 5234 self.assertEqual( 5235 self.track_by_id(self.track_id)["tags"], ["民谣", "现场"] 5236 ) 5237 5238 def test_empty_array_clears_tags(self): 5239 status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, {"tags": []}) 5240 self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) 5241 self.assertEqual(body["tags"], []) 5242 self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.track_id)["tags"], []) 5243 5244 def test_null_clears_tags(self): 5245 status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, {"tags": None}) 5246 self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) 5247 self.assertEqual(body["tags"], []) 5248 self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.track_id)["tags"], []) 5249 5250 def test_clearing_is_not_treated_as_unmodified(self): 5251 # 清空不能当作未修改：清空后原标签不再出现； 5252 # 之后再只改名称，标签仍是空数组，不会回到旧标签。 5253 status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, {"tags": []}) 5254 self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) 5255 self.assertEqual(body["tags"], []) 5256 5257 status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, {"title": "夜航（改名）"}) 5258 self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) 5259 self.assertEqual(body["tags"], []) 5260 self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.track_id)["tags"], []) 5261 5262 5263 class EditTagsSameSourceVersionsTest(ServerTestCase): 5264 """同一来源已有多个独立版本：编辑其中一条的标签不影响其他版本。""" 5265 5266 def setUp(self): 5267 super().setUp() 5268 self.first = self.create_track( 5269 title="夜航·首版", 5270 source="/music/yehang.flac", 5271 duration=243.5, 5272 description="首版说明", 5273 tags=["民谣", "现场"], 5274 ) 5275 self.second = self.create_track( 5276 title="夜航·重制", 5277 source="/music/yehang.flac", 5278 duration=250, 5279 description="重制说明", 5280 tags=["民谣", "重制"], 5281 save_as_new_version=True, 5282 ) 5283 5284 def test_editing_one_versions_tags_succeeds_without_conflict(self): 5285 # 来源未改动，不能触发重复来源冲突。 5286 status, body = self.patch(self.second["id"], {"tags": ["重制", "2026"]}) 5287 self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) 5288 self.assertEqual(body["id"], self.second["id"]) 5289 self.assertEqual(body["source"], "/music/yehang.flac") 5290 self.assertEqual(body["tags"], ["重制", "2026"]) 5291 5292 tracks = self.list_tracks() 5293 # 记录数量与列表顺序不变，仍是各自独立的两条。 5294 self.assertEqual( 5295 [t["id"] for t in tracks], [self.first["id"], self.second["id"]] 5296 ) 5297 self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.second["id"]), body) 5298 # 其他版本的标签与资料不受影响。 5299 self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.first["id"]), self.first) 5300 5301 5302 class EditTagsInvalidTest(ServerTestCase): 5303 """PATCH 提交非法标签：400 且 field=tags，整单失败不保存部分内容。""" 5304 5305 def setUp(self): 5306 super().setUp() 5307 self.track = self.create_track( 5308 title="夜航", 5309 source="/music/yehang.flac", 5310 duration=243.5, 5311 cover_url="https://img.example/yehang.png", 5312 description="首版说明", 5313 tags=["民谣", "现场"], 5314 ) 5315 self.track_id = self.track["id"] 5316 self.bystander = self.create_track( 5317 title="无关曲目", source="/music/other.flac", tags=["其他"], 5318 ) 5319 5320 def assert_tags_rejected(self, bad_tags): 5321 """非法标签（连同合法的新名称、新说明一起提交）必须整单失败。""" 5322 status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, { 5323 "title": "不应保存的新名称", 5324 "description": "不应保存的新说明", 5325 "tags": bad_tags, 5326 }) 5327 self.assertEqual(status, 400, body) 5328 # field 指向 tags，错误文字说明标签有误。 5329 self.assertEqual(body["field"], "tags") 5330 self.assertIn("标签", body["error"]) 5331 5332 def assert_everything_unchanged(self): 5333 tracks = self.list_tracks() 5334 # 记录数量与列表顺序不变。 5335 self.assertEqual( 5336 [t["id"] for t in tracks], 5337 [self.track_id, self.bystander["id"]], 5338 ) 5339 # 目标曲目的完整资料仍与提交前一致：同次请求里合法的新名称、 5340 # 新说明没有先写入；其他曲目也不受影响。 5341 self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.track_id), self.track) 5342 self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.bystander["id"]), self.bystander) 5343 5344 def test_tags_as_non_array_is_rejected(self): 5345 for bad in ("民谣", "民谣,现场", "", {"0": "民谣"}, 5, True): 5346 with self.subTest(bad=bad): 5347 self.assert_tags_rejected(bad) 5348 self.assert_everything_unchanged() 5349 5350 def test_non_string_items_are_rejected(self): 5351 for bad in ( 5352 [1], [0.5], [True], [False], [["民谣"]], [{"tag": "民谣"}], 5353 ): 5354 with self.subTest(bad=bad): 5355 self.assert_tags_rejected(bad) 5356 self.assert_everything_unchanged() 5357 5358 def test_valid_items_before_bad_item_do_not_save_partially(self): 5359 # 即使错误项前面已有合法标签，也不能保存部分内容。 5360 self.assert_tags_rejected(["合法新标签", 2, "另一个合法标签"]) 5361 self.assert_everything_unchanged() 5362 5363 def test_null_item_is_rejected_while_whole_null_clears(self): 5364 # 整个 tags 为 null 与数组中的 null 要区别对待： 5365 # 数组里的 null 是非法项，整个 tags 为 null 是清空。 5366 self.assert_tags_rejected([None]) 5367 self.assert_everything_unchanged() 5368 5369 status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, {"tags": None}) 5370 self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) 5371 self.assertEqual(body["tags"], []) 5372 self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.track_id)["tags"], []) 5373 5374 5375 if __name__ == "__main__": 5376 unittest.main() 5377

不新增任何曲目：接口为空，页面仍显示没有记录。 self.assertEqual(self.list_tracks(), []) self.assertIsNone(TRACK_LIST_RE.search(page)) self.assertIn("还没有曲目记录", page) # 时长框保留原文，便于直接修正。 self.assert_form_values(page, duration=typed) class HomeCreateDurationInvalidWithExistingTest(ServerTestCase): """已有曲目时首页时长失败：已有记录完整资料、数量与顺序保持原样。""" def setUp(self): super().setUp() self.first = self.create_track( title="已有曲目·甲", source="/music/existing-a.flac", duration=12, cover_url="https://img.example/a.png", description="甲的说明\n第二行", tags=["民谣"], ) self.second = self.create_track( title="已有曲目·乙", source="/music/existing-b.flac", duration=33.3, tags=["现场"], ) self.existing_ids = [self.first["id"], self.second["id"]] def assert_library_unchanged(self, page): tracks = self.list_tracks() # 数量不增加，列表顺序保持原样。 self.assertEqual([t["id"] for t in tracks], self.existing_ids) # 已有曲目的完整资料一条都没被改写。 self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.first["id"]), self.first) self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.second["id"]), self.second) # 失败页列表区仍只列出提交前的两条已有记录。 self.assertEqual( parse_listed_tracks(page), [(self.first["id"], "已有曲目·甲"), (self.second["id"], "已有曲目·乙")], ) def test_invalid_duration_saves_nothing_even_with_valid_metadata(self): for typed in ("-1", "-0.5", "普通文字", "NaN", "Infinity", "-Infinity", "1e999", "1e1000"): with self.subTest(typed=typed): status, _, page = self.post_create_form( self.create_form_fields( title="不应收录的候选", source=f"/音乐/候选-{len(typed)}.flac", duration=typed, cover_url="https://img.example/candidate.png", description="候选说明\n换行", tags="候选,新编", ) ) self.assertEqual(status, 400, page[:500]) self.assert_form_values(page, duration=typed) self.assert_library_unchanged(page) class HomeCreateDurationRetryAfterFailureTest(ServerTestCase): """首页时长失败后只修正时长再保存：只新增一条，资料来自回填。""" def setUp(self): super().setUp() self.first = self.create_track( title="已有曲目", source="/music/existing.flac", duration=9, cover_url="https://img.example/existing.png", description="已有说明", tags=["已有标签"], ) def test_fix_only_duration_saves_one_complete_new_record(self): # 第一次：除时长外的资料全部合法，时长写成普通文字导致 400。 description = "失败前填写的说明：中文\n第二行换行 \n" failed_fields = self.create_form_fields( title="修正后收录的曲目", source="/音乐/候选/录音.flac", duration="时长未知", cover_url="https://img.example/candidate.png", description=description, tags="候选,新编,候选", save_as_new_version=True, ) status, _, failed_page = self.post_create_form(failed_fields) self.assertEqual(status, 400) # 失败提交不写入任何曲目，已有记录保持原样。 self.assertEqual( [t["id"] for t in self.list_tracks()], [self.first["id"]] ) self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.first["id"]), self.first) # 用户在错误页只修正时长，保留其余回填（含另存勾选）再次保存。 retry_fields = self.create_fields_from_rendered_page(failed_page) retry_fields = [ ("duration", "243.5") if name == "duration" else (name, value) for name, value in retry_fields ] status, headers, _ = self.post_create_form(retry_fields) self.assertEqual(status, 303, headers) new_id = int( re.search(r"highlight=(\d+)$", headers["Location"]).group(1) ) self.assertNotEqual(new_id, self.first["id"]) # 只新增一条采用回填资料与修正后时长的曲目；失败提交不留额外记录。 tracks = self.list_tracks() self.assertEqual( [t["id"] for t in tracks], [self.first["id"], new_id] ) self.assertEqual(tracks[-1], { "id": new_id, "title": "修正后收录的曲目", "source": "/音乐/候选/录音.flac", "duration": 243.5, "cover_url": "https://img.example/candidate.png", "description": description, "tags": ["候选", "新编"], }) # 已有记录仍与提交前完全一致。 self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.first["id"]), self.first) # 成功后首页显示收录成功，列表时长与接口一致。 status, _, listing_page = self.server.get_page(headers["Location"]) self.assertEqual(status, 200) success = strip_tags(BANNER_SUCCESS_RE.search(listing_page).group(1)) self.assertIn("收录成功", success) self.assertIn(f"#{new_id}", success) self.assertEqual( parse_listed_durations(listing_page), ["9 秒", "243.5 秒"] ) def test_fix_duration_to_zero_then_to_unknown_each_adds_one_record(self): # 修正为“0”：收录一条已知零秒的曲目，显示“0 秒”而非未知。 failed_fields = self.create_form_fields( title="先负数后零", source="/music/fix-zero.flac", duration="-3", description="零秒修正", ) status, _, failed_page = self.post_create_form(failed_fields) self.assertEqual(status, 400) retry_fields = self.create_fields_from_rendered_page(failed_page) retry_fields = [ ("duration", "0") if name == "duration" else (name, value) for name, value in retry_fields ] status, headers, _ = self.post_create_form(retry_fields) self.assertEqual(status, 303, headers) zero_id = int(headers["Location"].rsplit("=", 1)[1]) self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(zero_id)["duration"], 0) status, _, listing_page = self.server.get_page(headers["Location"]) self.assertEqual( parse_listed_durations(listing_page), ["9 秒", "0 秒"] ) # 另一次失败后把时长框清空修正：收录一条未知时长的新曲目。 failed_fields = self.create_form_fields( title="先文字后留空", source="/music/fix-unknown.flac", duration="abc", ) status, _, failed_page = self.post_create_form(failed_fields) self.assertEqual(status, 400) retry_fields = self.create_fields_from_rendered_page(failed_page) retry_fields = [ ("duration", "") if name == "duration" else (name, value) for name, value in retry_fields ] status, headers, _ = self.post_create_form(retry_fields) self.assertEqual(status, 303, headers) unknown_id = int(headers["Location"].rsplit("=", 1)[1]) self.assertIsNone(self.track_by_id(unknown_id)["duration"]) # 两次失败都没有额外记录：只有已有 + 零秒 + 未知三条。 self.assertEqual( [t["id"] for t in self.list_tracks()], [self.first["id"], zero_id, unknown_id], ) class HomeCreateDurationWithSourceRulesTest(ServerTestCase): """时长保障与来源重复、另存为新版本的既有规则并存。""" def setUp(self): super().setUp() self.existing = self.create_track( title="夜航·首版", source="/music/yehang.flac", duration=243.5, tags=["民谣"], ) def test_duplicate_source_with_bad_duration_still_creates_nothing(self): # 来源重复且未另存、时长也非法：不新增任何记录，已有版本保持原样。 fields = self.create_form_fields( title="夜航·候选", source="/music/yehang.flac", duration="abc", tags=["候选"], ) status, _, page = self.post_create_form(fields) # 时长字段先于来源判重被校验，返回 400（而不是 409）。 self.assertEqual(status, 400, page[:500]) field_errors = [strip_tags(raw) for raw in FIELD_ERROR_RE.findall(page)] self.assertTrue(any("时长" in text for text in field_errors)) self.assertEqual( [t["id"] for t in self.list_tracks()], [self.existing["id"]] ) self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.existing["id"]), self.existing) def test_bad_duration_then_duplicate_source_then_save_new_version(self): # 第一次：时长非法被 400 拒绝（来源尚未走到判重），不留记录。 fields = self.create_form_fields( title="夜航·重录", source="/music/yehang.flac", duration="NaN", description="重录说明", tags=["重录"], ) status, _, failed_page = self.post_create_form(fields) self.assertEqual(status, 400) self.assertEqual( [t["id"] for t in self.list_tracks()], [self.existing["id"]] ) # 修正时长但仍未勾选另存：来源重复规则依旧生效，返回 409。 retry_fields = self.create_fields_from_rendered_page(failed_page) retry_fields = [ ("duration", "307.25") if name == "duration" else (name, value) for name, value in retry_fields ] status, _, conflict_page = self.post_create_form(retry_fields) self.assertEqual(status, 409, conflict_page[:500]) self.assertEqual( parse_conflict_items(conflict_page), [(self.existing["id"], "夜航·首版")], ) # 冲突拒绝同样不写入，且回填保留修正后的时长与其他本次资料。 self.assertEqual( [t["id"] for t in self.list_tracks()], [self.existing["id"]] ) self.assert_form_values( conflict_page, title="夜航·重录", source="/music/yehang.flac", duration="307.25", description="重录说明", ) # 在冲突页勾选“另存为新版本”再保存：新增一条独立标识的版本， # 资料来自回填，时长为修正后的值；原版本不被修改。 final_fields = self.create_fields_from_rendered_page(conflict_page) final_fields.append(("save_as_new_version", "1")) status, headers, _ = self.post_create_form(final_fields) self.assertEqual(status, 303, headers) new_id = int(headers["Location"].rsplit("=", 1)[1]) self.assertNotEqual(new_id, self.existing["id"]) new_record = self.track_by_id(new_id) self.assertEqual(new_record, { "id": new_id, "title": "夜航·重录", "source": "/music/yehang.flac", "duration": 307.25, "cover_url": "", "description": "重录说明", "tags": ["重录"], }) self.assertEqual( [t["id"] for t in self.list_tracks()], [self.existing["id"], new_id], ) self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.existing["id"]), self.existing) class EditTagsReplaceTest(ServerTestCase): """PATCH tags：本次提交的标签整体替换原标签，不追加、不新增记录。""" def setUp(self): super().setUp() self.track = self.create_track( title="夜航", source="/music/yehang.flac", duration=243.5, cover_url="https://img.example/yehang.png", description="首版说明\n第二行", tags=["民谣", "现场"], ) self.track_id = self.track["id"] self.bystander = self.create_track( title="无关曲目", source="/music/other.flac", tags=["其他"], ) def assert_rest_of_library_unchanged(self): tracks = self.list_tracks() # 修改的是原有记录：标识不变、不新增曲目，列表顺序不变。 self.assertEqual( [t["id"] for t in tracks], [self.track_id, self.bystander["id"]], ) self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.bystander["id"]), self.bystander) def test_submitted_tags_replace_old_tags(self): status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, {"tags": ["摇滚", "现场版"]}) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) # class CreateDurationValidApiTest(ServerTestCase):
    """收录接口（POST /api/tracks）：合法时长随本次资料保存，0 与未知分清。

    名称与来源合法、来源尚未收录时：有限的非负整数与小数都能作为秒数
    保存，成功返回 201 与完整曲目；省略时长或明确提交 null 都表示未知。
    随后读取曲目列表，同一标识下读到同一秒数或未知状态，名称、来源与
    本次提交的其他合法资料一致；列表按标识升序，新收录不改变已有曲目。
    """

    def full_payload(self, source, duration, **overrides):
        payload = {
            "title": "夜航·现场收录",
            "source": source,
            "duration": duration,
            "cover_url": "https://img.example/yehang.png",
            "description": "现场录音\n第二行：中文标点，保留",
            "tags": ["民谣", "现场", "民谣"],
        }
        payload.update(overrides)
        return payload

    def assert_created_and_listed(self, payload, expected_duration):
        status, body = self.server.request("POST", "/api/tracks", payload)
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, body)
        self.assertIsInstance(body["id"], int)
        # 成功返回完整曲目：时长为本次秒数，标签按既有规则裁剪去重，
        # 其余资料全部来自本次提交。
        self.assertEqual(body, {
            "id": body["id"],
            "title": payload["title"],
            "source": payload["source"],
            "duration": expected_duration,
            "cover_url": payload["cover_url"],
            "description": payload["description"],
            "tags": ["民谣", "现场"],
        })
        # 随后读取曲目列表：同一标识下读到同一时长与整条资料。
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(body["id"]), body)
        return body

    def test_integer_seconds_saved_as_integer(self):
        record = self.assert_created_and_listed(
            self.full_payload("/music/int-seconds.flac", 307), 307
        )
        # 整数值在响应与列表中都按整数呈现，不变成 307.0。
        self.assertIsInstance(record["duration"], int)

    def test_decimal_seconds_saved_without_rounding_or_conversion(self):
        # 有限非负小数按秒原样保存，不换算分钟、不四舍五入、不截断成整数。
        record = self.assert_created_and_listed(
            self.full_payload("/music/decimal-seconds.flac", 243.5), 243.5
        )
        self.assertIsInstance(record["duration"], float)

    def test_small_decimal_seconds_saved(self):
        for seconds in (0.5, 0.25, 12.75):
            with self.subTest(seconds=seconds):
                record = self.assert_created_and_listed(
                    self.full_payload(
                        f"/music/decimal-{seconds}.flac", seconds,
                        title=f"小数秒 {seconds}",
                    ),
                    seconds,
                )
                self.assertEqual(record["duration"], seconds)

    def test_zero_is_known_duration_not_unknown(self):
        # 0 是合法的已知时长：读回必须是数字 0，绝不能变成 null。
        record = self.assert_created_and_listed(
            self.full_payload(
                "/music/zero.flac", 0,
                description="开头静音\n0 秒前奏",
            ),
            0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(record["duration"], 0)
        self.assertIsNotNone(record["duration"])
        self.assertIsInstance(record["duration"], int)

    def test_omitted_duration_saved_as_unknown(self):
        payload = {
            "title": "未知时长曲目",
            "source": "/music/omitted-duration.flac",
            "cover_url": "https://img.example/unknown.png",
            "description": "时长待补",
            "tags": ["待补"],
        }
        status, body = self.server.request("POST", "/api/tracks", payload)
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, body)
        # 省略时长表示未知：成功记录中的时长为 null，不是 0。
        self.assertIsNone(body["duration"])
        self.assertEqual(body, {
            "id": body["id"],
            "title": "未知时长曲目",
            "source": "/music/omitted-duration.flac",
            "duration": None,
            "cover_url": "https://img.example/unknown.png",
            "description": "时长待补",
            "tags": ["待补"],
        })
        self.assertIsNone(self.track_by_id(body["id"])["duration"])

    def test_explicit_null_saved_as_unknown(self):
        # 明确提交 null 与省略时长语义相同，都表示未知。
        payload = {
            "title": "显式未知曲目",
            "source": "/music/null-duration.flac",
            "duration": None,
        }
        status, body = self.server.request("POST", "/api/tracks", payload)
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, body)
        self.assertIsNone(body["duration"])
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(body["id"]), body)

    def test_known_and_unknown_distinct_records_coexist_in_id_order(self):
        # 连续收录：已知整数、已知小数、0、未知各一条，验证列表按标识
        # 升序展示，各标识的时长状态互不串扰。
        known_int = self.assert_created_and_listed(
            self.full_payload("/music/order-int.flac", 307,
                              title="顺序·整数"),
            307,
        )
        unknown = self.server.create_track(
            title="顺序·未知", source="/music/order-unknown.flac",
        )
        self.assertIsNone(unknown["duration"])
        zero = self.assert_created_and_listed(
            self.full_payload("/music/order-zero.flac", 0,
                              title="顺序·零"),
            0,
        )
        decimal = self.assert_created_and_listed(
            self.full_payload("/music/order-decimal.flac", 243.5,
                              title="顺序·小数"),
            243.5,
        )
        tracks = self.list_tracks()
        self.assertEqual(
            [t["id"] for t in tracks],
            [known_int["id"], unknown["id"], zero["id"], decimal["id"]],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            [t["duration"] for t in tracks],
            [307, None, 0, 243.5],
        )

    def test_new_create_does_not_change_existing_records(self):
        # 新增曲目不改变已有曲目的资料，列表仍按标识升序。
        first = self.create_track(
            title="已有曲目·甲",
            source="/music/existing-a.flac",
            duration=12,
            cover_url="https://img.example/a.png",
            description="甲的说明\n第二行",
            tags=["民谣"],
        )
        second = self.create_track(
            title="已有曲目·乙", source="/music/existing-b.flac",
            duration=None,
        )
        before_ids = [first["id"], second["id"]]

        new_record = self.assert_created_and_listed(
            self.full_payload("/music/existing-c.flac", 95.5,
                              title="已有曲目·丙"),
            95.5,
        )
        tracks = self.list_tracks()
        self.assertEqual(
            [t["id"] for t in tracks], before_ids + [new_record["id"]]
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(first["id"]), first)
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(second["id"]), second)


class CreateDurationInvalidApiTest(ServerTestCase):
    """收录接口：时长非法时 400 且 field=duration，整单不写入。

    时长为负数或非有限数值，或写成字符串、布尔值、数组、对象时拒绝；
    数字字符串即使看起来像合法秒数也不自动转换，false 不能变成 0。
    其他资料都合法也不能保存部分内容：空曲库仍为空，已有曲库的记录
    数量、顺序与各条完整资料保持提交前状态。
    """

    # 与非法时长一起提交的其他资料全部合法：即使如此也整单不写入。
    def full_payload(self, source, duration):
        return {
            "title": "夜航·候选",
            "source": source,
            "duration": duration,
            "cover_url": "https://img.example/candidate.png",
            "description": "候选说明：中文、换行\n第二行",
            "tags": ["候选", "新编"],
        }

    def assert_duration_rejected(self, payload):
        status, body = self.server.request("POST", "/api/tracks", payload)
        self.assertEqual(status, 400, body)
        # field 指向 duration，错误文字说明时长有误；不是来源冲突响应。
        self.assertEqual(body["field"], "duration")
        self.assertIn("时长", body["error"])
        self.assertNotIn("existing", body)

    def test_negative_numbers_are_rejected(self):
        for bad in (-1, -0.01, -243.5):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                self.assert_duration_rejected(
                    self.full_payload(f"/music/neg-{bad}.flac", bad)
                )
                self.assertEqual(self.list_tracks(), [])

    def test_non_finite_values_are_rejected(self):
        # NaN、Infinity、-Infinity 以及解析后溢出为 Infinity 的指数写法，
        # 都是非有限数值（通过原始 JSON 文本发送），不能保存。
        for raw_fragment in ("NaN", "Infinity", "-Infinity", "1e999",
                             "-1e999"):
            with self.subTest(raw=raw_fragment):
                status, body = self.post_raw(
                    '{"title": "夜航·候选", '
                    f'"source": "/music/nonfinite-{raw_fragment}.flac", '
                    f'"duration": {raw_fragment}, '
                    '"description": "不应保存的说明"}'
                )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400, body)
                self.assertEqual(body["field"], "duration")
                self.assertIn("时长", body["error"])
                self.assertEqual(self.list_tracks(), [])

    def test_numeric_strings_are_rejected_without_coercion(self):
        # 数字文字即使看起来是合法秒数也不能自动转换成数字；
        # 网页允许在输入框里填写数字文字，不改变 JSON 接口对数字类型的要求。
        for bad in ("243", "243.5", "0", "-1", " 12 ", ""):
            with self.subTest(bad=repr(bad)):
                self.assert_duration_rejected(
                    self.full_payload(f"/music/str-{bad!r}.flac", bad)
                )
                self.assertEqual(self.list_tracks(), [])

    def test_boolean_is_rejected_without_becoming_zero_or_one(self):
        # false 不能变成 0，true 也不能变成 1。
        for bad in (False, True):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                self.assert_duration_rejected(
                    self.full_payload(f"/music/bool-{bad}.flac", bad)
                )
                self.assertEqual(self.list_tracks(), [])

    def test_array_and_object_are_rejected(self):
        for bad in ([], [243.5], {}, {"seconds": 243.5}):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                self.assert_duration_rejected(
                    self.full_payload(f"/music/complex-{type(bad).__name__}.flac", bad)
                )
                self.assertEqual(self.list_tracks(), [])

    def test_other_scalar_types_are_rejected(self):
        for bad in ("abc", "null", "NaN"):
            with self.subTest(bad=repr(bad)):
                self.assert_duration_rejected(
                    self.full_payload(f"/music/text-{bad}.flac", bad)
                )
                self.assertEqual(self.list_tracks(), [])

    def test_zero_accepted_but_string_zero_rejected(self):
        # 对照保障：数字 0 正常收录，而字符串 "0" 被拒绝，二者不能混淆。
        status, body = self.server.request(
            "POST", "/api/tracks",
            self.full_payload("/music/real-zero.flac", 0),
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, body)
        self.assertEqual(body["duration"], 0)

        self.assert_duration_rejected(
            self.full_payload("/music/string-zero.flac", "0")
        )
        # 字符串 "0" 没有产生第二条记录。
        tracks = self.list_tracks()
        self.assertEqual(len(tracks), 1)
        self.assertEqual(tracks[0]["source"], "/music/real-zero.flac")
        self.assertEqual(tracks[0]["duration"], 0)


class CreateDurationInvalidWithExistingApiTest(ServerTestCase):
    """已有曲库时收录接口时长失败：数量、顺序与各条完整资料保持原样。"""

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.first = self.create_track(
            title="已有曲目·甲",
            source="/music/existing-a.flac",
            duration=12,
            cover_url="https://img.example/a.png",
            "description": "甲的说明\n第二行",
            tags=["民谣"],
        )
        self.second = self.create_track(
            title="已有曲目·乙",
            source="/music/existing-b.flac",
            duration=33.3,
            description="",
            tags=["现场"],
        )
        self.bystander = self.create_track(
            title="无关曲目", source="/music/other.flac", duration=None,
        )
        self.expected_ids = [
            self.first["id"], self.second["id"], self.bystander["id"],
        ]

    def full_payload(self, source, duration):
        return {
            "title": "不应收录的候选",
            "source": source,
            "duration": duration,
            "cover_url": "https://img.example/candidate.png",
            "description": "不应保存的候选说明\n第二行",
            "tags": ["候选", "新编"],
        }

    def assert_library_unchanged(self):
        tracks = self.list_tracks()
        # 记录数量不增加，顺序仍是标识升序。
        self.assertEqual([t["id"] for t in tracks], self.expected_ids)
        # 各条完整资料保持提交前状态，不能留下只有名称或来源的残缺记录。
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.first["id"]), self.first)
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.second["id"]), self.second)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.track_by_id(self.bystander["id"]), self.bystander
        )

    def test_every_invalid_shape_leaves_library_untouched(self):
        cases = [
            ("dict", -1),
            ("dict", -0.25),
            ("dict", "243.5"),
            ("dict", "0"),
            ("dict", False),
            ("dict", True),
            ("dict", []),
            ("dict", {}),
            ("raw", "NaN"),
            ("raw", "Infinity"),
            ("raw", "-Infinity"),
            ("raw", "1e999"),
        ]
        for index, (kind, value) in enumerate(cases):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                source = f"/music/fresh-duration-case-{index}.flac"
                if kind == "dict":
                    status, body = self.server.request(
                        "POST", "/api/tracks",
                        self.full_payload(source, value),
                    )
                else:
                    status, body = self.post_raw(
                        '{"title": "不应收录的候选", '
                        f'"source": "{source}", '
                        f'"duration": {value}, '
                        '"description": "不应保存的候选说明"}'
                    )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400, body)
                self.assertEqual(body["field"], "duration")
                self.assertIn("时长", body["error"])
                self.assert_library_unchanged()

    def test_valid_create_after_duration_failures_extends_library(self):
        # 多次时长失败后，一次合法收录仍能成功，接在已有记录之后，
        # 失败请求不留下额外记录。
        for bad in (-1, "243.5", False):
            status, _ = self.server.request(
                "POST", "/api/tracks",
                {
                    "title": "失败候选",
                    "source": f"/music/never-written-{bad!r}.flac",
                    "duration": bad,
                    "description": "不应保存",
                },
            )
            self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assert_library_unchanged()

        status, body = self.server.request("POST", "/api/tracks", {
            "title": "补收录的曲目",
            "source": "/music/after-duration-failures.flac",
            "duration": 240,
            "description": "修正后收录",
        })
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, body)
        self.assertEqual(
            [t["id"] for t in self.list_tracks()],
            self.expected_ids + [body["id"]],
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(body["id"]), body)
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.first["id"]), self.first)
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.second["id"]), self.second)


class CreateDurationNewVersionApiTest(ServerTestCase):
    """同一来源明确另存新版本：时长规则与普通收录完全相同。"""

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.first = self.create_track(
            title="夜航·首版",
            source="/music/yehang.flac",
            duration=243.5,
            cover_url="https://img.example/yehang.png",
            description="首版说明",
            tags=["民谣", "现场"],
        )

    def test_valid_duration_saved_under_new_id_with_original_intact(self):
        payload = {
            "title": "夜航·重制",
            # 仅首尾空白不同仍视为同一来源，但本次明确要求另存。
            "source": " \t/music/yehang.flac\n ",
            "duration": 250,
            "cover_url": "https://img.example/yehang-remaster.png",
            "description": "重制说明",
            "tags": ["民谣", "重制"],
            "save_as_new_version": True,
        }
        status, body = self.server.request("POST", "/api/tracks", payload)
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, body)
        self.assertNotEqual(body["id"], self.first["id"])
        # 合法时长随本次资料保存到新标识下。
        self.assertEqual(body, {
            "id": body["id"],
            "title": "夜航·重制",
            "source": "/music/yehang.flac",
            "duration": 250,
            "cover_url": "https://img.example/yehang-remaster.png",
            "description": "重制说明",
            "tags": ["民谣", "重制"],
        })
        tracks = self.list_tracks()
        self.assertEqual(
            [t["id"] for t in tracks], [self.first["id"], body["id"]]
        )
        # 原版本的时长与其他资料保持原样，没有被覆盖。
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.first["id"]), self.first)

    def test_null_duration_new_version_leaves_known_original_intact(self):
        # 新版本时长未知，原版本仍是已知时长，两者互不影响。
        status, body = self.server.request("POST", "/api/tracks", {
            "title": "夜航·现场",
            "source": "/music/yehang.flac",
            "duration": None,
            "save_as_new_version": True,
        })
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, body)
        self.assertIsNone(body["duration"])
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(body["id"])["duration"], None)
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.first["id"]), self.first)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.track_by_id(self.first["id"])["duration"], 243.5
        )

    def assert_rejected_without_new_version(self, payload, *, raw=False):
        if raw:
            status, body = self.post_raw(payload)
        else:
            status, body = self.server.request(
                "POST", "/api/tracks", payload
            )
        self.assertEqual(status, 400, body)
        # 即使已明确同意另存，也报告时长错误。
        self.assertEqual(body["field"], "duration")
        self.assertIn("时长", body["error"])
        # 不新增版本，不覆盖旧曲目。
        tracks = self.list_tracks()
        self.assertEqual([t["id"] for t in tracks], [self.first["id"]])
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.first["id"]), self.first)

    def test_invalid_duration_with_flag_creates_no_new_version(self):
        for bad in (-1, "243.5", "0", False, True, [], {}):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                self.assert_rejected_without_new_version({
                    "title": "夜航·失败重录",
                    "source": "/music/yehang.flac",
                    "duration": bad,
                    "cover_url": "https://img.example/new.png",
                    "description": "不应保存的重录说明",
                    "tags": ["重录"],
                    "save_as_new_version": True,
                })

    def test_non_finite_duration_with_flag_creates_no_new_version(self):
        for raw_fragment in ("NaN", "Infinity", "-Infinity", "1e999"):
            with self.subTest(raw=raw_fragment):
                self.assert_rejected_without_new_version(
                    '{"title": "夜航·失败重录", '
                    '"source": "/music/yehang.flac", '
                    f'"duration": {raw_fragment}, '
                    '"description": "不应保存的重录说明", '
                    '"save_as_new_version": true}',
                    raw=True,
                )

class CreateDurationValidApiTest(ServerTestCase):
    """收录接口（POST /api/tracks）：合法时长随本次资料保存，0 与未知分清。

    名称与来源合法、来源尚未收录时：有限的非负整数与小数都能作为秒数
    保存，成功返回 201 与完整曲目；省略时长或明确提交 null 都表示未知。
    随后读取曲目列表，同一标识下读到同一秒数或未知状态，名称、来源与
    本次提交的其他合法资料一致；列表按标识升序，新收录不改变已有曲目。
    """

    def full_payload(self, source, duration, **overrides):
        payload = {
            "title": "夜航·现场收录",
            "source": source,
            "duration": duration,
            "cover_url": "https://img.example/yehang.png",
            "description": "现场录音\n第二行：中文标点，保留",
            "tags": ["民谣", "现场", "民谣"],
        }
        payload.update(overrides)
        return payload

    def assert_created_and_listed(self, payload, expected_duration):
        status, body = self.server.request("POST", "/api/tracks", payload)
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, body)
        self.assertIsInstance(body["id"], int)
        # 成功返回完整曲目：时长为本次秒数，标签按既有规则裁剪去重，
        # 其余资料全部来自本次提交。
        self.assertEqual(body, {
            "id": body["id"],
            "title": payload["title"],
            "source": payload["source"],
            "duration": expected_duration,
            "cover_url": payload["cover_url"],
            "description": payload["description"],
            "tags": ["民谣", "现场"],
        })
        # 随后读取曲目列表：同一标识下读到同一时长与整条资料。
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(body["id"]), body)
        return body

    def test_integer_seconds_saved_as_integer(self):
        record = self.assert_created_and_listed(
            self.full_payload("/music/int-seconds.flac", 307), 307
        )
        # 整数值在响应与列表中都按整数呈现，不变成 307.0。
        self.assertIsInstance(record["duration"], int)

    def test_decimal_seconds_saved_without_rounding_or_conversion(self):
        # 有限非负小数按秒原样保存，不换算分钟、不四舍五入、不截断成整数。
        record = self.assert_created_and_listed(
            self.full_payload("/music/decimal-seconds.flac", 243.5), 243.5
        )
        self.assertIsInstance(record["duration"], float)

    def test_small_decimal_seconds_saved(self):
        for seconds in (0.5, 0.25, 12.75):
            with self.subTest(seconds=seconds):
                record = self.assert_created_and_listed(
                    self.full_payload(
                        f"/music/decimal-{seconds}.flac", seconds,
                        title=f"小数秒 {seconds}",
                    ),
                    seconds,
                )
                self.assertEqual(record["duration"], seconds)

    def test_zero_is_known_duration_not_unknown(self):
        # 0 是合法的已知时长：读回必须是数字 0，绝不能变成 null。
        record = self.assert_created_and_listed(
            self.full_payload(
                "/music/zero.flac", 0,
                description="开头静音\n0 秒前奏",
            ),
            0,
        )
        self.assertEqual(record["duration"], 0)
        self.assertIsNotNone(record["duration"])
        self.assertIsInstance(record["duration"], int)

    def test_omitted_duration_saved_as_unknown(self):
        payload = {
            "title": "未知时长曲目",
            "source": "/music/omitted-duration.flac",
            "cover_url": "https://img.example/unknown.png",
            "description": "时长待补",
            "tags": ["待补"],
        }
        status, body = self.server.request("POST", "/api/tracks", payload)
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, body)
        # 省略时长表示未知：成功记录中的时长为 null，不是 0。
        self.assertIsNone(body["duration"])
        self.assertEqual(body, {
            "id": body["id"],
            "title": "未知时长曲目",
            "source": "/music/omitted-duration.flac",
            "duration": None,
            "cover_url": "https://img.example/unknown.png",
            "description": "时长待补",
            "tags": ["待补"],
        })
        self.assertIsNone(self.track_by_id(body["id"])["duration"])

    def test_explicit_null_saved_as_unknown(self):
        # 明确提交 null 与省略时长语义相同，都表示未知。
        payload = {
            "title": "显式未知曲目",
            "source": "/music/null-duration.flac",
            "duration": None,
        }
        status, body = self.server.request("POST", "/api/tracks", payload)
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, body)
        self.assertIsNone(body["duration"])
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(body["id"]), body)

    def test_known_and_unknown_distinct_records_coexist_in_id_order(self):
        # 连续收录：已知整数、已知小数、0、未知各一条，验证列表按标识
        # 升序展示，各标识的时长状态互不串扰。
        known_int = self.assert_created_and_listed(
            self.full_payload("/music/order-int.flac", 307,
                              title="顺序·整数"),
            307,
        )
        unknown = self.server.create_track(
            title="顺序·未知", source="/music/order-unknown.flac",
        )
        self.assertIsNone(unknown["duration"])
        zero = self.assert_created_and_listed(
            self.full_payload("/music/order-zero.flac", 0,
                              title="顺序·零"),
            0,
        )
        decimal = self.assert_created_and_listed(
            self.full_payload("/music/order-decimal.flac", 243.5,
                              title="顺序·小数"),
            243.5,
        )
        tracks = self.list_tracks()
        self.assertEqual(
            [t["id"] for t in tracks],
            [known_int["id"], unknown["id"], zero["id"], decimal["id"]],
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            [t["duration"] for t in tracks],
            [307, None, 0, 243.5],
        )

    def test_new_create_does_not_change_existing_records(self):
        # 新增曲目不改变已有曲目的资料，列表仍按标识升序。
        first = self.create_track(
            title="已有曲目·甲",
            source="/music/existing-a.flac",
            duration=12,
            cover_url="https://img.example/a.png",
            description="甲的说明\n第二行",
            tags=["民谣"],
        )
        second = self.create_track(
            title="已有曲目·乙", source="/music/existing-b.flac",
            duration=None,
        )
        before_ids = [first["id"], second["id"]]

        new_record = self.assert_created_and_listed(
            self.full_payload("/music/existing-c.flac", 95.5,
                              title="已有曲目·丙"),
            95.5,
        )
        tracks = self.list_tracks()
        self.assertEqual(
            [t["id"] for t in tracks], before_ids + [new_record["id"]]
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(first["id"]), first)
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(second["id"]), second)

class CreateDurationInvalidWithExistingApiTest(ServerTestCase):
    """已有曲库时收录接口时长失败：数量、顺序与各条完整资料保持原样。"""

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.first = self.create_track(
            title="已有曲目·甲",
            source="/music/existing-a.flac",
            duration=12,
            cover_url="https://img.example/a.png",
            "description": "甲的说明\n第二行",
            tags=["民谣"],
        )
        self.second = self.create_track(
            title="已有曲目·乙",
            source="/music/existing-b.flac",
            duration=33.3,
            description="",
            tags=["现场"],
        )
        self.bystander = self.create_track(
            title="无关曲目", source="/music/other.flac", duration=None,
        )
        self.expected_ids = [
            self.first["id"], self.second["id"], self.bystander["id"],
        ]

    def full_payload(self, source, duration):
        return {
            "title": "不应收录的候选",
            "source": source,
            "duration": duration,
            "cover_url": "https://img.example/candidate.png",
            "description": "不应保存的候选说明\n第二行",
            "tags": ["候选", "新编"],
        }

    def assert_library_unchanged(self):
        tracks = self.list_tracks()
        # 记录数量不增加，顺序仍是标识升序。
        self.assertEqual([t["id"] for t in tracks], self.expected_ids)
        # 各条完整资料保持提交前状态，不能留下只有名称或来源的残缺记录。
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.first["id"]), self.first)
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.second["id"]), self.second)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.track_by_id(self.bystander["id"]), self.bystander
        )

    def test_every_invalid_shape_leaves_library_untouched(self):
        cases = [
            ("dict", -1),
            ("dict", -0.25),
            ("dict", "243.5"),
            ("dict", "0"),
            ("dict", False),
            ("dict", True),
            ("dict", []),
            ("dict", {}),
            ("raw", "NaN"),
            ("raw", "Infinity"),
            ("raw", "-Infinity"),
            ("raw", "1e999"),
        ]
        for index, (kind, value) in enumerate(cases):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                source = f"/music/fresh-duration-case-{index}.flac"
                if kind == "dict":
                    status, body = self.server.request(
                        "POST", "/api/tracks",
                        self.full_payload(source, value),
                    )
                else:
                    status, body = self.post_raw(
                        '{"title": "不应收录的候选", '
                        f'"source": "{source}", '
                        f'"duration": {value}, '
                        '"description": "不应保存的候选说明"}'
                    )
                self.assertEqual(status, 400, body)
                self.assertEqual(body["field"], "duration")
                self.assertIn("时长", body["error"])
                self.assert_library_unchanged()

    def test_valid_create_after_duration_failures_extends_library(self):
        # 多次时长失败后，一次合法收录仍能成功，接在已有记录之后，
        # 失败请求不留下额外记录。
        for bad in (-1, "243.5", False):
            status, _ = self.server.request(
                "POST", "/api/tracks",
                {
                    "title": "失败候选",
                    "source": f"/music/never-written-{bad!r}.flac",
                    "duration": bad,
                    "description": "不应保存",
                },
            )
            self.assertEqual(status, 400)
        self.assert_library_unchanged()

        status, body = self.server.request("POST", "/api/tracks", {
            "title": "补收录的曲目",
            "source": "/music/after-duration-failures.flac",
            "duration": 240,
            "description": "修正后收录",
        })
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, body)
        self.assertEqual(
            [t["id"] for t in self.list_tracks()],
            self.expected_ids + [body["id"]],
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(body["id"]), body)
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.first["id"]), self.first)
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.second["id"]), self.second)


class CreateDurationNewVersionApiTest(ServerTestCase):
    """同一来源明确另存新版本：时长规则与普通收录完全相同。"""

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.first = self.create_track(
            title="夜航·首版",
            source="/music/yehang.flac",
            duration=243.5,
            cover_url="https://img.example/yehang.png",
            description="首版说明",
            tags=["民谣", "现场"],
        )

    def test_valid_duration_saved_under_new_id_with_original_intact(self):
        payload = {
            "title": "夜航·重制",
            # 仅首尾空白不同仍视为同一来源，但本次明确要求另存。
            "source": " \t/music/yehang.flac\n ",
            "duration": 250,
            "cover_url": "https://img.example/yehang-remaster.png",
            "description": "重制说明",
            "tags": ["民谣", "重制"],
            "save_as_new_version": True,
        }
        status, body = self.server.request("POST", "/api/tracks", payload)
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, body)
        self.assertNotEqual(body["id"], self.first["id"])
        # 合法时长随本次资料保存到新标识下。
        self.assertEqual(body, {
            "id": body["id"],
            "title": "夜航·重制",
            "source": "/music/yehang.flac",
            "duration": 250,
            "cover_url": "https://img.example/yehang-remaster.png",
            "description": "重制说明",
            "tags": ["民谣", "重制"],
        })
        tracks = self.list_tracks()
        self.assertEqual(
            [t["id"] for t in tracks], [self.first["id"], body["id"]]
        )
        # 原版本的时长与其他资料保持原样，没有被覆盖。
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.first["id"]), self.first)

    def test_null_duration_new_version_leaves_known_original_intact(self):
        # 新版本时长未知，原版本仍是已知时长，两者互不影响。
        status, body = self.server.request("POST", "/api/tracks", {
            "title": "夜航·现场",
            "source": "/music/yehang.flac",
            "duration": None,
            "save_as_new_version": True,
        })
        self.assertEqual(status, 201, body)
        self.assertIsNone(body["duration"])
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(body["id"])["duration"], None)
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.first["id"]), self.first)
        self.assertEqual(
            self.track_by_id(self.first["id"])["duration"], 243.5
        )

    def assert_rejected_without_new_version(self, payload, *, raw=False):
        if raw:
            status, body = self.post_raw(payload)
        else:
            status, body = self.server.request(
                "POST", "/api/tracks", payload
            )
        self.assertEqual(status, 400, body)
        # 即使已明确同意另存，也报告时长错误。
        self.assertEqual(body["field"], "duration")
        self.assertIn("时长", body["error"])
        # 不新增版本，不覆盖旧曲目。
        tracks = self.list_tracks()
        self.assertEqual([t["id"] for t in tracks], [self.first["id"]])
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.first["id"]), self.first)

    def test_invalid_duration_with_flag_creates_no_new_version(self):
        for bad in (-1, "243.5", "0", False, True, [], {}):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                self.assert_rejected_without_new_version({
                    "title": "夜航·失败重录",
                    "source": "/music/yehang.flac",
                    "duration": bad,
                    "cover_url": "https://img.example/new.png",
                    "description": "不应保存的重录说明",
                    "tags": ["重录"],
                    "save_as_new_version": True,
                })

    def test_non_finite_duration_with_flag_creates_no_new_version(self):
        for raw_fragment in ("NaN", "Infinity", "-Infinity", "1e999"):
            with self.subTest(raw=raw_fragment):
                self.assert_rejected_without_new_version(
                    '{"title": "夜航·失败重录", '
                    '"source": "/music/yehang.flac", '
                    f'"duration": {raw_fragment}, '
                    '"description": "不应保存的重录说明", '
                    '"save_as_new_version": true}',
                    raw=True,
                )

完成。为 `POST /api/tracks` 收录接口的 `duration` 字段补齐了回归测试，全部 223 个测试通过（原有 202 + 新增 21），未改动 `app.py` 的任何行为。

## 新增内容（`test_app.py`）

**辅助方法**
- `ServerTestCase.post_raw()`：按原始 JSON 文本发送 POST，用于 NaN/Infinity/1e999 等非标准 JSON 片段（对齐已有的 `patch_raw`）。

**四个测试类**（紧邻既有收录接口测试，命名/风格与 PATCH 时长测试一致）

1. **`CreateDurationValidApiTest`**（8 例）— 合法时长：整数保持 int 形态、小数不换算/不截断、0 读回为数字零而非 null；省略 `duration` 与显式 `null` 都保存为未知；随后 GET 列表同标识读到同一秒数/未知状态及完整资料；已知/未知/零多条记录共存时列表按 id 升序；新收录不改变已有曲目。
2. **`CreateDurationInvalidApiTest`**（7 例）— 空曲库下：负数、NaN/Infinity/溢出、数字字符串（含 `"0"`、`" 12 "`）、布尔值（false 不变 0）、数组、对象均返回 400，`field=="duration"`、错误文字含“时长”、无 `existing`，曲库仍为空；并含数字 0 通过 vs 字符串 `"0"` 拒绝的对照。
3. **`CreateDurationInvalidWithExistingApiTest`**（2 例）— 已有 3 条曲目时，12 种非法形态逐一验证记录数量、id 顺序与各条完整资料保持提交前状态；多次失败后合法收录仍能正常追加。
4. **`CreateDurationNewVersionApiTest`**（4 例）— `save_as_new_version: true` 另存新版本：合法时长与本次资料存到新标识、原版本整条保持原样（含未知新版本不影响已知原版本）；非法时长即使已同意另存仍报 400 duration 错误，不新增版本、不覆盖旧曲目（覆盖负数/字符串/布尔/数组/对象与非有限值）。

同时在模块 docstring 的“收录”部分补充了一条接口时长保障说明，记录所固定的既有规则。
